environment.description: Quarkus 2.16 Lambda handler deployed in AWS Lambda with VPC configuration. S3 access exclusively through interface VPC endpoint vpce-0f9e8d7c6b (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3) with a scoped endpoint policy. The endpoint policy document uses a StringLike condition on s3:prefix requiring 'reports/${aws:PrincipalTag/team}/*' and restricts s3:PutObject to keys matching the condition key s3:object-lock-legal-hold-status absent AND aws:ResourceTag/writable equals 'true'. Additionally, the endpoint policy has an explicit Deny for any PutObject where the S3 key contains format-special characters (%, .., $) via a StringNotLike condition on s3:prefix. The Lambda execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/BoundaryNoArbitraryS3Write) that restricts PutObject to keys matching 'reports/report-[a-zA-Z0-9-]*\.json' regex via a custom IAM condition operator. API Gateway has a request model with JSON Schema validation requiring filenamePattern to match '^report-[a-zA-Z0-9%][a-zA-Z0-9%-]*$' - however this regex intentionally allows % characters for date formatting.

config.api_gateway: REST API with request model validation (filenamePattern: '^report-[a-zA-Z0-9%][a-zA-Z0-9%-]*$')
